correctness.rationale: The explicit bipartition separates eight vertices A and eight B with A-neighborhood masks (19,38,76,137,97,194,148,56). Tsukuda, Corollary 4.11, gives Ind(G) ≃ suspension of the Alexander dual K of the hypergraph on A. Independently generated K has 140 nonempty faces, face vector (8,28,56,40,8). A 67-pair staged matching has exact critical masks {1,14,22,82,164,204}; 424 oriented Hasse covers topologically sort, and signed 3-to-2 Morse degree vector is identically zero. The resulting one-point/4 two-cell/one three-cell CW complex has trivial 3-cell attaching map by Hurewicz, so K ≃ wedge^4 S2 wedge S3 and its suspension proves the claim. A second source-script direct 1090-face GP(8,3) check with primitive rank-one integer Morse boundary corroborates; not used as proof of an unbounded family.
